title: Pareto frontier and multi-objective evolution
summary: dev6 retains dev5 independent objective vectors/frontiers and adds a hard-feasibility gate before dominance. Pareto rank describes tradeoffs only among candidates that are allowed to compete.
authority: Executable ooRexx ML dev6 source/tests are authoritative; dev5 establishes Pareto mechanics and dev6 establishes constrained-Pareto semantics.
invariants: MLObjectiveSet preserves each MLObjective and its MINIMIZE/MAXIMIZE direction independently.
A candidate dominates another only when it is no worse on every objective and strictly better on at least one.
Crowding distance is diversity evidence inside a Pareto front, not a replacement objective.
MLParetoGeneticAlgorithm uses deterministic rank/crowding selection and the same journalled RNG/State-of-the-Nation rollback discipline as the scalar GA.
A complete Pareto GA run evaluates and publishes the final bred population before returning.
Human review may choose among frontier tradeoffs without rewriting objective evidence or pretending one non-dominated candidate is mathematically superior.
Hard feasibility is decided before Pareto dominance; an infeasible candidate cannot enter any Pareto front regardless of objective values.
procedure: Assess hard constraints before constructing objective vectors/fronts when non-tradable eligibility requirements exist.
Declare two or more MLObjective objects in an MLObjectiveSet.
Evaluate each candidate to an MLObjectiveVector with one score per objective.
Compute fronts with MLParetoAnalyzer and retain rank/crowding evidence.
For evolution, drive MLParetoGeneticAlgorithm under MLGeneticPolicy and deterministic RNG.
Use MLParetoRetentionSelector to bound durable material while preserving frontier diversity.
Route remaining frontier choices to human/policy review rather than inventing hidden scalar weights.

provenance.claim: Objective sets/vectors, Pareto fronts, crowding, bounded retention and branchable Pareto GA implementation.
Regression proves the final bred Pareto population is evaluated before a complete run returns.
Regression proves rollback/replay reproduces Pareto offspring and deterministic RNG state.
Recovered-audio reference distance, pre-limiter over-range and post-limiter clipping are exposed as independent objectives.
Adds hard-feasibility gating around Pareto analysis and evolution without changing dev5 objective-vector semantics.
